brief:
UN Special Coordinator for Middle East Peace Tor Wennesland, known by his surname Mladinov in Arabic usage, called on Israel to permit the entry of a technocratic committee and an international force into Gaza, the Ma'an news agency reported. His demands address post-conflict governance and security arrangements in the territory.

The statement reflects international efforts to shape conditions for Gaza's administration and stabilization following military operations. Mladinov's call for international involvement signals UN concern over the territory's institutional capacity and security oversight.
title: UN envoy demands Israel allow technocratic committee and international force into Gaza
